verdict.rationale: The GitHub README shows a CLI deep crawl that explicitly selects a breadth-first strategy and a configurable page cap (`--deep-crawl bfs --max-pages 10`). The official CLI is documented, and deep crawls also support crash recovery via `resume_state` and `on_state_change` for long runs. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the BFS strategy and its max-pages parameter (e.g. via the Python API, not just a one-line CLI example), and independent or hands-on corroboration of deep-crawl behavior at scale.
